what_it_is.prose: ISRO's 2026 test campaign shows Gaganyaan progressing through system qualification. Major crew-module qualification tests were completed in July 2026, an integrated main-parachute air-drop test was completed on 7 July, and IADT-02 in April validated parachute deceleration using an IAF Chinook and Navy recovery. ISRO identifies the human-rated LVM3/HRLV as the launcher path. The dossier therefore records the programme as Development rather than claiming an operational crewed flight.
